This is a community-fork release of MouseFix, based on [matreshka15/MouseFix](https://github.com/matreshka15/MouseFix). Original concept by [Marvin Lehmann](https://github.com/marvinlehmann), with improvements by [matreshka15](https://github.com/matreshka15). The original MIT license and credits are preserved.

Changes:
- Clearer setup, configuration, startup, and build instructions.
- Matching multi-size mouse icons for the executable, tray, and visible settings dialog.
- Automated Windows x64 and x86 builds and release packaging.
- Consistent application and executable version metadata.

Download MouseFix-x64.exe for 64-bit Windows or MouseFix-x86.exe for 32-bit Windows. MouseFix-Windows.zip includes both executables, the original license, README, and startup helper. Exit any running MouseFix instance before launching the new executable.

Both architectures are built in CI. These binaries are unsigned. MouseFix remains a background tray utility.
